owner_calls.question: Stage S5#20 (text 'As Graviton, Talbot kills Hale', both card lines) and st-glenn-talbot|st-robin-hinton stage S5#21 (text 'As Graviton, Talbot kidnaps Robin', card A 'later kidnaps as Graviton') use the name 'Graviton'. Fandom cites that codename only to a marvel.com interview, and Wikipedia uses it only in production notes. Neither source shows the name said on screen. Keep it, or reword as 'With his gravitonium powers'?
options: Reword to 'With his gravitonium powers' / 'after taking the gravitonium'
owner_calls.evidence: The Fandom Glenn Talbot infobox cites 'codenames = Graviton' to the marvel.com article 'Adrian Pasdar on the One Who Will Save Us All'. Its Behind the Scenes uses the name only in showrunner quotes. Wikipedia's season 5 page: '...merging with Talbot when he enters the Rebirth chamber and becomes Graviton' (production section). Neither source gives an on-screen use, so I am not sure enough to change it.

owner_calls.question: The All Hail the King stage text names him 'Xu Wenwu'. The one-shot only calls him the real leader of the Ten Rings / the real Mandarin. The name comes from Shang-Chi (a later title). Drop the name from this stage's text (e.g. 'serves the real leader behind the Mandarin name')? The pair itself already shows Wenwu's card.
options: Drop the name from the text, keep the cards as they are
owner_calls.evidence: All Hail the King plot: Norriss reveals the real reason for the interview is to break Trevor out so he can meet 'the actual leader of the Ten Rings'. The one-shot never names Wenwu.
